title: Page 307
transc:
Washington Mar 13th 1863
For Hooker Despatches just
Recvd from Fort Monroe say
that enemy <deletion>230 PM</deletion> <insertion>is</insertion> investing
Suffolk Halleck 230 PM funds


Fort Monroe 430 PM Apl 13 
Suffolk 4 PM for Hooker Intelligent &
reliable Deserters state that the force
in my front of thirty five
thousand men under Long street has
come from Fredksburg in expectation of
inaction on your part D H
Hill is said to Be advancing
from N see <deletion>Charlottesville</deletion> <insertion>John</insertion> J Peck
Major General fun down this way
